== Biography ==
He was born in 1821 and died in 1897 and buried at Glenn's Chapel in Lyon County, Kentucky.<ref>Find a Grave, database and images (https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/75698511/james-marion-glasgow : accessed 26 January 2022), memorial page for James Marion Glasgow (1821–1897), {{FindAGrave|75698511}}, citing Glenns Chapel Methodist Church Cemetery, Eddyville, Lyon County, Kentucky, USA ; Maintained by Tammie and Edward Georgen (contributor 47524835) .
</ref>

He married first to Sarah Ann Colson on 28 Dec 1852 in Stewart County, TN.
